question: Should this default-off batch publisher merge before its documented remote synthetic-target performance and recovery proof is available?
rationale: The implementation intentionally adds workflow-driven state-publication automation while its rollout plan reserves remote proof and activation for later; maintainers must choose whether the guarded code is acceptable before that evidence.

options.title: Merge behind the existing flag
options.body: Merge after required checks and review, then require the documented synthetic-target proof before enabling the repository variable.

options.title: Require remote proof before merge
options.body: Hold the PR until it includes synthetic-target evidence for failure recovery, fencing, and multi-item publication.

options.title: Split rollout infrastructure
options.body: Land only the protocol work and defer the scheduled publisher until remote proof is available.

recommendation.title: Merge behind the existing flag
recommendation.body: Merge after required checks and review, then require the documented synthetic-target proof before enabling the repository variable.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns the submitted implementation and staged rollout plan, though repository owners retain the final rollout decision.
